quarterly_data.signal: Vertex's 10-K: 2025 net income was $3,953.2 million (2024: net loss of $(535.6) million) and diluted EPS was $15.32. Research and development expenses were $3,909.5 million and selling, general and administrative expenses $1,753.1 million; total R&D and SG&A rose to $5.7 billion from $5.1 billion, primarily due to increased investment to commercialize new products and to advance the R&D pipeline. 2025 included a $379.0 million intangible asset impairment charge, and cost of sales comprised $601.5 million of product costs and $1,049.8 million of royalties. Purchases of property and equipment were $437.6 million versus $297.7 million in 2024. Revenue outside the U.S. was $3,460.3 million in Europe and $992.4 million in other markets. Total cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities were $12.3 billion at December 31, 2025, up from $11.2 billion.
